pairs.target: yòu guò liǎngrì , tǎ wéi dào liànxí jiān shí , sòng yuǎn zhèngzài bān yìzhī mùxiá , jiàn tā jìnmén , xiān wèn ruò pángbiān yǒu shēngxiǎng , tā xiǎng xiān zhuǎntóu , háishì xiān gù shǒulǐ de dōngxī .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō děi kàn shì shénme shēngyīn , sòng yuǎn jiāng xiázi gē zài zhuōshàng , shuō jīnrì jiù zhè zhī , bù cóng mén hòu tiào rén , tǎ wéi zhè cái jiāng bāo fàngxià .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着卷好袖口，高凳仍留在身后，左脚站在不用深弯的位置，先拿空木托，让两边都留在眼里。

pairs.target: mùxiá fàngzài yòubiān zhuōshàng , wèizhì kàndejiàn , sòng yuǎn mànmàn tiē zhǎng , wéi lǎoshī jiāng xiá gài qīngqīng fàngxià yícì , shēngyīn bǐ yuànlǐ guānmén hái xiǎo .
pairs.english: The wooden box sat on the table to the right, its position visible; Song Yuan slowly applied palm contact; Teacher Vey gently lowered the box lid once, its sound even quieter than a door closing in the courtyard.

pairs.english: Tavi's head turned first, his right hand turning after it too; the left marker stayed where it was, but he no longer held it in mind, and by the time he called a stop he was already annoyed.

pairs.target: " wǒ tīngjiàn le , yě méi diào . "
pairs.english: “I heard it, and nothing fell either.”

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuō jīnrì búshì bǐ shuí méi diào , tǎ wéi wàng zhe tā , wèn nà jiūjìng yào zuò nǎ jiàn , wéi lǎoshī shēnshǒu jiāng xiá gài chóngxīn zhī zhù , méiyǒu xiān jiào tā zài lái .

pairs.target: tā shuō ruò yào tīngjiàn biàn shōu , jiù bùnéng yìbiān jiào tā kàn xiá , yìbiān yòu ràng tā cāi nǐ yào buyào jìxù , xiān dìng yíjiàn , sòng yuǎn diǎntóu , jiāng shǒu yě chè kāi .
pairs.english: She said if hearing it meant cancel, then they could not at once tell him to look at the box and also make him guess whether they wanted him to continue; settle one task first; Song Yuan nodded and withdrew his hand too.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zìjǐ xuǎn tīngjiàn biàn shōu , shēngyīn qīngzhòng bú huàn , wèizhì bù nuó , ruò méi rènqīng liǎngbiān , biàn zhào píngcháng jiàotíng , bú wèi děng shēngyīn yìngchēng .

pairs.hanzi: 维老师查他手指，问眼里累不累，他说不累，摸杯沿也清楚，歇够才将原来那两片铁取来。

pairs.target: mùxiá méi tì tā jiē zhù yí bàng , yě méi ràng tā duō liú bàn xī , tǎ wéi zuòxià shí què yìzhí kànzhe zìjǐ de yòuzhǎng , xiàng fāngcái xiān sōngkāi de nà yíxià hái zài nàlǐ .
pairs.english: The wooden box had not taken a staff strike for him, nor let him retain anything another half-breath; yet on sitting, Tavi kept watching his own right palm, as if that earlier impulse to loosen first were still there.

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng mǎshàng dá néng , tíng le yíxià , shuō fāngcái xiǎng xiān zhǎo shēngyīn , hòulái zhǐgù zhe shōu , ruò shēnhòu yǒurén yào zǒu , zìjǐ hái méi kànjiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to answer yes immediately, paused a moment, and said he had first wanted to locate the sound, then cared only about cancelling; if someone had needed to pass behind, he had not seen them yet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想马上答能，停了一下，说方才想先找声音，后来只顾着收，若身后有人要走，自己还没看见。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu tì tā bǎ nàge rén bǔ jìn jīnrì zhè yìhuí , zhǐ jiào tā jiāng zhè jù yě liúzài pángbiān , miǎnde míngrì zhǐ jìde zìjǐ méiyǒu xiān sōngshǒu .

pairs.english: Tavi opened the door for him, asking whether he had to return a sound as well; Song Yuan said if he asked again, he could deliver the box himself; he immediately let the door go to let him through.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替他拉门，问是不是还要还够一声，宋远说若再问，便自己把匣子送去，他立刻松开门让他过。
